Re: Dispute of Account ACC-437902

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account ACC-437902, citing concerns about the account's validity due to the lack of substantiated proof. We understand that you have requested validation of this account.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Texas state law, we are required to investigate your dispute. We will review the account information and verify the original creditor, Metro Physicians Group, to determine the accuracy of the account.

We have confirmed that the account was charged off on 2024-06-18, and the current balance is 10221.03. Unfortunately, we do not have a record of any payments made on this account.

We will conduct a thorough investigation and provide you with a response regarding the validity of the account. We will also provide any requested validation information, as required by law.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this account further if you believe that our investigation does not resolve your concerns. You may also request that we remove the account from our records if we are unable to validate it.

We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and will keep you informed of our progress.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]

RE: Account reference: ACC-356736

Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Dispute of Amount on Account ACC-356736

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the amount on your account, ACC-356736. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Missouri state law.

We have reviewed our records and confirmed that the current balance on your account is $6,598.77. We also confirm that the original creditor on this account is Heartland Savings Bank.

We understand that you have expressed concerns about the frequency of our communications. We want to assure you that we will comply with all applicable laws and regulations regarding debt collection, including the FDCPA's requirements for communication frequency and content.

We will investigate your dispute regarding the amount on your account and will respond to you in a timely manner. If our investigation confirms that the amount is incorrect, we will take the necessary steps to correct it.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt and may continue to do so. You may also request validation of the debt, which we will provide if requested.

We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to resolving this matter. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]
Revenue Group
Compliance Department
